exposure: postpartum weight retention (PPWR) 4 weeks post-delivery of first birth
outcome: large-for-gestational-age (LGA) infants in the second pregnancy
cohort: This nationwide prospective birth cohort analysis included 3137 women who delivered their first two live singletons between 2011 and 2014.
finding: Postpartum weight retention measured at 4 weeks post-delivery of the first birth was not associated with an increased risk of large-for-gestational-age infants in the second pregnancy, irrespective of maternal pre-pregnancy BMI.
